headline: Disney+ and Hulu Raise Prices Up to 13 Percent
summary: Disney is raising prices for Disney+ and Hulu, part of a broader trend of streaming price increases, according to TechCrunch and Ars Technica. Ars Technica says prices are rising by up to 13 percent after Disney doubled its profits, and that the Disney+ ad-free plan now costs more than Netflix's.
